thread:
Emma Patel: hey team — getting pages about generation timeouts hitting the hosted API in us-west2, looks like a spike in 5xxs from the embed route :grimacing:
Raj Singh: saw the alert, oncall got paged. I'm starting a quick triage now. status: degraded throughput, 502s ~ 15%  over last 6m
Oncall Bot: paging @Raj Singh (oncall) — incident created (INC-1769). Priority: P1. Link: https://incident.redwood.internal/INC-1769 :rotating_light:
Raj Singh: joining bridge in 2, can someone post a concise customer-facing line we can use in zendesk and the status page? Need short + longer detail.
Marta (CS): draft for zendesk quick-reply: "Thanks for flagging — we're investigating increased timeouts for the generation API in US-West. We're prioritizing a fix and will update within 30 minutes. If you have a request ID or example, please reply and we'll correlate."
Theo: status page short line: "Degraded responses for Generation API (US-West). Engineers investigating." Longer note: "Customers may see timeouts or 5xx errors for text generation in the US-West region. We're actively investigating and will share updates. No data loss detected."
Emma Patel: nice. can we also include an escalation script for CS if a customer is very impacted? simple checklist: 1) collect request IDs 2) request start/end times 3) ask for reproducible prompt snippet (if not PII) 4) offer to reroute to eu-west temporarily.
Marta (CS): putting that into a Zendesk macro (name: investigation_ack_v2). Macro body:
```
Thanks — we're investigating degraded responses for generation in US-West. Could you share the request ID(s) and an example prompt (if possible)? If you'd prefer, we can attempt a temporary reroute to EU while we investigate. ETA for an update: 30 minutes.
```
Raj Singh: ops checklist for oncall (short):
- confirm alerts + graph spikes (latency/5xx)
- check recent deployments (svc-gen / image tags / infra)
- tail infra logs: grpc/gunicorn / nginx
- check autoscale + GPU pool utilization
- if rollback needed: follow the rolling rollback runbook
- post status update to status.redwood.io and #support
SRE Bot: Recent deploys: svc-gen:release-2026-03-14-18:22 by matt.deploy. No automatic rollback.
Theo: include the minimal statuspage API curl for ops to push quickly:
```
curl -X POST https://api.status.redwood.io/v1/incidents \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STATUS_API' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"component_ids":["gen-us-west"], "status":"investigating", "message":"Degraded responses for Generation API (US-West). Engineers are investigating."}'
```
Emma Patel: CS quick-replies for high-visibility customers (short templates):
- Acknowledgement: "We're actively investigating and have prioritized your traffic. We'll follow up with a targeted update in 15 minutes and can escalate a dedicated engineer if needed."
- Interim workaround: "As a temporary measure we can route your requests to EU (latency tradeoff). Would you like us to enable that?"
Marta (CS): adding a step for handoff: when oncall is handing off, please paste the runbook link + current hypotheses + actions taken so far. Example handoff snippet:
```
Handoff: investigating 5xx spike for gen-us-west. Hypothesis: overloaded GPU pool after a new model rollout. Actions: scaled GPU pool + rolled back release-2026-03-14-18:22 to release-2026-03-14-17:50, monitoring.
```
Raj Singh: update — I rolled back the recent model rollout (svc-gen) and scaled up the dedicated pool by +2 nodes. Traffic error rate dropping to ~6% now. Will keep watch. Posting status update.
Oncall Bot: incident INC-1769 status changed to "investigating" -> "mitigating" by Raj Singh.
Emma Patel: updated zendesk macro 'investigation_ack_v2' to include an optional line for customers we reroute: "We rerouted your traffic to EU temporarily; expect slightly higher latency."
Marta (CS): suggested internal comms blurb for #support (copy): "Status: Mitigating — generation API errors in US-West. Rollback performed; error rates decreasing. CS: continue to use investigation_ack_v2. Will update at +30 and +60."
Theo: created a temporary incident-specific macro set: [investigation_ack_v2, reroute_offer, urgent_escalate_eng]. Recommend CS use them and attach request IDs when available.
Raj Singh: final note for oncall handoff in 30m: record current error rate, recent actions (rollback + scale), metrics link, and the hypothesis. If error rate stabilizes <1% for 10m, close incident and publish resolved note.
SRE Bot: Metrics window: https://metrics.redwood.internal/d/ops/gen-us-west?from=now-1h&to=now.
Marta (CS): thanks. I'll queue a templated customer update for the major impacted list and start tagging priority customers in zendesk.
Emma Patel: good work, team. keep short updates only on this thread to avoid noise. :thumbsup:
Theo: copying the final status update for the status page (ready to paste): "Mitigation in progress — rollback applied and additional capacity added. Error rates decreasing; further updates in 30 minutes."
